'''Tay Khang''', or just '''Kang''', is a [[Tai languages|Tai language]] of Laos. There is confusion with [[Kháng language|Kháng]]. Schliesinger (2003) reports an area of habitation being in [[Bolikhamsai Province]], Laos.<ref name=e25/>

Religion of speakers are Theravada Buddhism and animism.

An audio recording in this language by [[Michel Ferlus]] is available online from the [[Pangloss Collection]].
